module: Flowgraph node "im Race Times" (category repeat_instant, tag scenario). Draws in imgui the race times of a vehicle by calling race:inDrawTimes(vehId, im, detailed) on the received raceData object. Inputs: raceData ('raceData' table) and vehId (number). If the function returns true (click in the UI), the data.detailed option is toggled.

drawMiddle.desc: Empty: no drawing in the node body.

work.desc: If raceData is present, draws the vehicle's times and toggles detailed mode when inDrawTimes returns true.
